answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 66422 Country: United Kingdom Title: Closing one's eyes in salah Question: What is the ruling regarding closing one’s eyes in salah due to pain? Answer ID: 66422 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1063/1116/L=10/1437) It is makrooh to offer salah closing one’s eyes without a valid reason. However, there is no harm if someone closes his eyes due to pain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
